name: Garware Hi-Tech Films Limited
summary: Garware Hi-Tech Films Limited manufactures and sells polyester films in India, the United States, and internationally. The company offers paint protection and sun control films. It also offers defendo-dual reflective, spectrally selective, deco vista, safety, designer, privacy, reflective, IR rejection, writable, antigraffity, and whiteboard films, as well as HP films. In addition, the company provides lidding, liner release, metallized, lamination, packaging, shrink, thermal, heat sealable, graphic, and electrical films, as well as insulation and low oligomer films. Its products are used in automobiles, buildings, label, electric motor insulation and cable insulation, sealed compressors motors, sequin application films, TV and LCD screen, packaging, and other applications. The company was formerly known as Garware Polyester Limited and changed its name to Garware Hi-Tech Films Limited in April 2021. Garware Hi-Tech Films Limited was founded in 1933 and is based in Mumbai, India.
